title: ProducerLotRecordV1
description: Public, immutable producer-lot declaration. Holochain action author is the cryptographic author; the lot producer_ref must equal did_for_author(action.author). This proves authorship only, not legal producer status or food safety.

producer_author.description: Canonical Holochain AgentPubKey serialized in the entry. The integrity callback requires exact equality with the Create action signer.

previous_revision.description: Holochain ActionHash of revision N-1. Null only for revision 1. The integrity callback loads the valid prior record and checks same author, lot_ref, product_ref and sequential revision.
